draft.subject: a result worth sharing
draft.body:
Hi Kate,

One result worth sharing. We helped Dunmore Supply cut order-entry time by 60% in six weeks, without replacing their ERP.

If it's useful, I can send a short write-up by reply. Want me to?

evidence.text: Data Entry Specialist. Key incoming purchase orders and invoices into Dynamics GP; strong attention to detail.
Must have 3+ years with Microsoft Dynamics GP.

facts.wording: Built a single operations platform covering CRM, orders, inventory, vendors and analytics for an automotive retail and services business (Wish Wheels).
Built a citizen-services digital transformation platform with workflow automation and dashboards (MP Online Digital).
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.
